smear.en: Put them on the baking pan and smear them with egg whites.
smear.zh: 將它們放在烤盤上並且塗抹蛋白。

assassinate.en: They attempted to assassinate the president.

infuse.en: This soap is infused with natural fragrances.
infuse.zh: 这块肥皂里添加了天然香料。

overlap.zh: 他们俩的影子重叠在一起。

variant.en: Different variants of Shanghainese differ greatly with each other.
Drents is a group of variants of the Low Saxon regional language.
variant.zh: 德伦特方言是低地撒克逊地区的一个方言群。

excavation.en: Tom is an archaeologist leading the excavations near Rome.
excavation.zh: 湯姆是位考古學家，在領導羅馬附近的發掘項目。

admittedly.en: Admittedly, it wasn't the best meal I've ever eaten.
admittedly.zh: 不可否认，那并不是我吃过最好的一顿饭。

soybean.en: Milking soybeans must be a tiring task, all that squeezing.
soybean.zh: 擠大豆肯定是很累人的工作，需要不停地擠壓。

indispensable.zh: 空氣是生命中不可或缺的。

revolt.en: The revolt happened day by day.

dye.zh: 瑪麗把頭髮染成藍色的。

pamphlet.en: This pamphlet is free of charge.

buckle.en: The roof of the house suddenly buckled.
It's the law: always buckle your safety belt in cars and airplanes.
buckle.zh: 法律規定，在車輛和飛機上，一定要扣上安全帶。

swarm.en: We were attacked by swarms of bees.
swarm.zh: 我們被一大群蜜蜂攻擊。

swarm.en: A swarm of hornets attacked the children.
swarm.zh: 一窩黃蜂襲擊了孩子們。

soothe.en: The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
soothe.zh: 那個玩具絨毛摸起來很柔軟，讓人感到舒適。

obstruction.en: The accusations are shocking: money laundering, tax evasion and obstruction of justice.
obstruction.zh: 这些指控令人震惊:洗钱、逃税和妨碍司法公正。

tow.en: The policeman didn't tow your car away.

peninsula.en: Have you already been to the Korean Peninsula?

puddle.en: Reflections could be seen in the puddles.
Angrily, he stomped on the puddle, splashing mud everywhere.
puddle.zh: 他憤怒地踐踏水坑，弄得泥水四濺。

doubtful.en: I'm doubtful that he's going to come.
I am doubtful whether he will come.

dismay.en: Tom gave a cry of dismay.

outgoing.en: Layla was very outgoing, loving, and caring.
outgoing.zh: 萊拉很外向、有愛心、會照顧人。

fragrant.en: She planted fragrant olives in the garden.

banquet.en: Some Shanghainese hold large banquets when they get married.
banquet.zh: 上海人结婚，有的人家办酒宴场面很大。

equilibrium.en: We could apply the theory of punctuated equilibrium to languages.
equilibrium.zh: 我们可以把间断平衡理论应用到语言上。

luxurious.en: The new theatre looks very luxurious.

irresistible.zh: 你這身穿著讓人無法抗拒。

bouquet.en: Sami put Layla's bouquet in his room.
bouquet.zh: 薩米將萊拉的花束放在了他的房間裡。

bouquet.en: She held a large bouquet of artificial flowers in her hands.
bouquet.zh: 她手裡拿著一大束假花。

tutor.en: He is a tutor for the math department.

chalk.en: Give me a piece of chalk.
Please bring me two pieces of chalk.
chalk.zh: 给我拿两根粉笔来，谢谢。

fortress.en: The author of Fortress Besieged is Qian Zhongshu.

touching.en: Let go of my arm! I can't stand people touching me.
touching.zh: 放開我的手臂！我不能忍受有人碰我。

touching.en: Is the wire live? I can tell just by touching it.
touching.zh: 电线有没有电？我一摸就知道。

insulin.en: Have you been keeping up a normal diet since the last shot of insulin?
insulin.zh: 你最後一次注射胰島素之後有正常飲食嗎？

barber.en: The barber gave him a haircut.
I'm going to the barber today.

brisk.en: Sales were brisk during the holiday season but have dropped off since.
brisk.zh: 假期期間銷售業績暢旺，但之後就下滑了。

cramped.en: I want to move out of this cramped room as soon as I can.
cramped.zh: 我想尽快从这个不透气的屋子里出去。

flea.en: Let's go to the flea market tomorrow.
flea.zh: 我們明天去跳蚤市場吧。

flea.en: Can you tell me where the flea market is?
flea.zh: 你能告訴我跳蚤市場在哪裡嗎？

tolerant.en: It is said that Dutch are tolerant.
tolerant.zh: 人們常說荷蘭人很寬容。

rainfall.en: We had a heavy rainfall last night.

heave.zh: 我把我自己用力拉起來。

glaze.en: How come this fucking apartment has no double-glazing? I'm freezing.
glaze.zh: 为什么这个他妈的房子没有双层玻璃，我快要冷死了。

dread.en: Why do you think animals dread fire?
dread.zh: 你覺得動物為什麼會怕火呢？

dread.en: Cleaning up the house is truly my most dreaded task.
dread.zh: 打扫屋子真的是我最害怕的工作。

syllable.en: How many syllables are in this word?
How many syllables does this word have?

deprivation.en: Sleep deprivation increases risk of heart attacks.
deprivation.zh: 睡眠不足增加心臟病發作的危險。

pollute.en: This water was polluted by oil.

duplicate.en: This contract is made in duplicate.

redeem.en: The only thing that will redeem mankind is co-operation.
redeem.zh: 合作是人類唯一的救贖。

folly.en: You should be ashamed of your folly.
folly.zh: 你應該為你的愚蠢感到羞恥。

stray.en: Tom has found another stray dog.

sprawl.zh: 城市擴張會對環境造成破壞。

dreadful.en: The consequences of Sendai's earthquake were dreadful!
dreadful.zh: 仙台地震的结果很恐怖。

dissertation.en: I've been really busy with my graduation dissertation recently.
dissertation.zh: 我最近真忙于我的毕业论文。

terminology.en: Legal terminology is usually incomprehensible to non-specialists.
terminology.zh: 法律術語是大多數普通人無法理解的。

terminology.en: Legal terminology is not comprehensible to most laypeople.
terminology.zh: 法律術語是大多數普通人無法理解的。

shriek.en: She shrieked whenever she saw a spider.

numb.en: The swimmers were numb with cold.

amazement.zh: 他張開了嘴巴說不出話來。

humiliate.en: I didn't want to humiliate you.

heavenly.en: The Heavenly Timber Immolation is a kind of ancient ritual.
heavenly.zh: 燔柴祭天是一種古老的儀式。

extinct.en: The dodo is an extinct animal.
extinct.zh: 渡渡鸟是已灭绝的动物。

extinct.en: Butterflies of this species are now extinct.
extinct.zh: 這品種的蝴蝶現在已經絕種了。

cupboard.en: Tom opened the shoe cupboard and took the shoes out.

futile.en: There is nothing which exacts a higher price than revenge, yet is so futile.
futile.zh: 没有什么东西比复仇更昂贵，更无益。

idol.zh: 汤姆是一位青少年偶像。

conspicuous.en: The scar on his forehead is conspicuous.
conspicuous.zh: 他額頭上的疤痕很醒目。

hustle.en: Come on, we need to hustle.

braid.zh: 薩米把頭髮編成了辮子。
湯姆把鬍子編成了辮子。

carcass.zh: 他们发现了一具长颈鹿的尸体。

radius.en: Find the radius of the incircle of the triangle.
radius.zh: 求三角形內切圓的半徑。

rearrange.en: Could you rearrange this list so it's in alphabetical order?
rearrange.zh: 你能把這清單按字母順序排列嗎？

rearrange.en: If I could rearrange the alphabet, I would put U and I together.
rearrange.zh: 如果我可以把英文字母重新排序，我會把「U」和「I」放在一起。

digest.en: Food you eat that you don't like will not be digested well.
digest.zh: 你吃不喜歡的食物會消化不良。

prolong.en: Prolonging the discussion will bring us nowhere.
prolong.zh: 繼續討論下去，也不會有甚麼結果。

dismal.en: The rain made the autumn day dismal.
dismal.zh: 雨让秋天的日子阴沉沉的。

sloppy.en: He's very sloppy in his dress.

vicinity.en: We live in the vicinity of the school.

humility.en: Humility often achieves more than pride.

anthem.en: Estonia has its own national anthem.
anthem.zh: 爱沙尼亚有它自己的国歌。

bulky.en: This box is too bulky to carry.
bulky.zh: 這個箱子太笨重了無法攜帶。

exempt.en: Nothing is exempt from Murphy's Law.
exempt.zh: 沒有任何事物能逃脫墨菲定律。

ultraviolet.en: Ultraviolet rays can cause skin cancer.
The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
ultraviolet.zh: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

sulfur.en: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
sulfur.zh: 硫磺燃燒著藍色的火焰。

sane.en: Rousseau was mad but influential; Hume was sane but had no followers.
sane.zh: 盧梭是瘋狂的, 但有影響力; 休謨是理智的, 但沒有追隨者。

deity.en: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
deity.zh: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？

auditorium.en: I knew it would be hot in the auditorium.
auditorium.zh: 我就知道禮堂裡會很熱。

plentiful.en: She shed plentiful tears when her beloved dog was killed in an accident.
plentiful.zh: 她目睹愛犬在意外中離世，不禁淚如泉湧。

starvation.en: Many children die of starvation in Africa.
starvation.zh: 在非洲有许多孩子死于饥饿。

starvation.en: The poor child was on the verge of starvation.
starvation.zh: 那可憐的孩子快餓死了。

rot.zh: 水果一般不久就会腐烂。

warranty.en: A good warranty would make me feel better.
warranty.zh: 優質的保固能讓我安心。

pollen.en: Probably you are allergic to pollen or dust.
pollen.zh: 你可能对花粉或灰尘过敏。

rusty.en: Sami put the rusty fork in the dishwasher.
rusty.zh: 薩米將生鏽的叉子放進了洗碗機。

permeate.en: The air was permeated by the smell of the sea.
permeate.zh: 空氣中充斥著海的氣息。

defiant.en: He often takes a defiant attitude toward us.
defiant.zh: 他常以反抗的態度對我們。

tan.en: The plane is landing in Tan Son Nhat airport.
tan.zh: 飞机降落在新山一机场。

amass.en: He amassed a large fortune before he died.
amass.zh: 他死前累積了龐大的財富。

amass.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
amass.zh: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

slum.en: There are many slums in Mexico.
slum.zh: 在墨西哥有很多貧民窟。

traverse.en: There must be some way of traversing the river.

thermometer.en: The thermometer went down below zero.
thermometer.zh: 溫度計上的溫度跌到了零度以下。

vibrate.en: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
vibrate.zh: 飛機開始震動的時候，乘客們都緊張了起來。

parachute.zh: 湯姆的降落傘沒有打開。

speedy.en: I wish you a speedy recovery!
I wish you a speedy recovery.

sly.en: He did it on the sly.

greasy.en: I bought a handmade dried persimmon in Hsinchu. It tastes sweet but not greasy.
greasy.zh: 我在新竹買了一塊手工柿餅，味道甜而不膩。

stitch.en: A stitch in time saves nine.
stitch.zh: 小洞及時補，免遭大洞苦。

voltage.en: For this test, I bought a voltage tester.
voltage.zh: 為了這次的測試，我特地買了電壓測試儀。

grieve.en: He grieved at the death of his best friend.
grieve.zh: 他为他最要好的朋友的死感到悲伤。

drizzle.zh: 我喜歡下小雨，不喜歡下大雨。

incompetent.en: The world is full of incompetent doctors.
incompetent.zh: 社会上满是不称职的医生。

obscene.en: One must be respectful when speaking, and not say obscene things.
obscene.zh: 开口要有礼貌，不讲下流话。

invader.en: They defended their country against the invaders.
invader.zh: 他们抵御入侵者，保卫了国家。

ventilation.zh: 這房間的通風設備很好。

ventilation.en: The ventilation here is really bad.

query.en: Any further queries should be made via the customer service number below.
query.zh: 如有任何其他疑問，請撥打下方的客服電話。

gloomy.en: The smoggy air of Beijing makes me feel gloomy.
gloomy.zh: 北京的雾霾天气让我心情不太好。

troublesome.en: In any case, it's troublesome, isn't it?
troublesome.zh: 无论怎样，都很讨厌，不是吗？

troublesome.en: It is the first step which is troublesome.

imprisonment.en: The judge sentenced him to one year's imprisonment.
imprisonment.zh: 法官判了他一年有期徒刑。

blizzard.en: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.
blizzard.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

blizzard.en: Our journey went smoothly until we ran into a blizzard.
blizzard.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

endow.en: He is endowed with unusual ability in mathematics.
endow.zh: 他天生具有不尋常的數學能力。

vocation.en: The "family manager" is a profession, occupation, vocation.
vocation.zh: “一家之主”是一份专业工作、事业和使命。

stale.en: The beggar is collecting stale bread.
stale.zh: 这名乞丐在收集干面包。

obedience.en: We should always act in obedience to the law.
obedience.zh: 我們無論如何也應該遵守法律。

obedience.en: Then I'll work on the principle that deference is no substitute for obedience.
obedience.zh: 那我就恭敬不如从命啦。

traitor.en: We have a traitor among us.
The world is full of traitors.

iceberg.en: The sea looked quite green, and large icebergs were floating about.
iceberg.zh: 海水看起來一片碧綠，巨大的冰山漂浮在周圍。

parrot.zh: 鸚鵡懂得模仿人類說話。

botanical.en: We found many strange plants in a botanical garden.
botanical.zh: 我們在一家植物園裏找到了許多稀奇古怪的植物。

emblem.en: The dragon is one of the cultural emblems of China.

willow.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
willow.zh: 柳枝在微风中轻轻荡悠。

bland.en: Life would become bland without you.
bland.zh: 如果沒有你，我的人生就會變得空白一片。

ridicule.en: We ridiculed him because of that thing.
ridicule.zh: 我们因为那件事嘲笑他。

ridicule.en: She not only ridiculed him, but also drove him out.
ridicule.zh: 她不止嘲笑了他，还把他赶了出去。

rectangle.en: Roll the pastry into a rectangle.
Roll the dough into a rectangle.

invaluable.zh: 他的援助真是雪中送炭。

invaluable.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
invaluable.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

enthusiastically.en: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
enthusiastically.zh: 她热忱地投身于这份光荣的事业。

grope.en: She groped for the light switch in the dark.
grope.zh: 她摸黑摸不到燈的開關。

fluffy.en: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
fluffy.zh: 这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。

fluffy.en: Fluffy white clouds drift across the sky one by one.
fluffy.zh: 一片一片的白雲在上空飄過。

stern.en: The teacher gave his pupils a stern telling-off.
stern.zh: 老師把學生狠狠地罵了一頓。

stern.en: The teacher gave her pupils a stern telling-off.
stern.zh: 老師把學生狠狠地罵了一頓。

innate.en: He has an innate love of adventure.

zeal.en: Zeal for your house will consume me.
zeal.zh: 我為你的殿，心裡焦急，如同火燒。

exemplary.en: I must say, his behaviour is exemplary.
exemplary.zh: 我该说，他的行为是典范。

deplete.zh: 這件事耗盡了他的財力。

gait.en: He has the gait of a duck.
gait.zh: 他走路走得像隻鴨子似的。

gleam.en: We saw the gleam of a distant lighthouse.
gleam.zh: 我們看到了遠方燈塔的微光。

gleam.en: The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.
gleam.zh: 湖水在耀眼的陽光下閃閃發亮。

adept.en: Hackers are adept at getting around computer security measures.
adept.zh: 黑客很會利用電腦安全措拖的漏洞。

thrift.en: I took it to the thrift shop.

subtract.en: Subtract three from eight and you get five.
Subtract two from ten and you have eight.

nourish.en: The role of the placenta is to nourish the foetus.
nourish.zh: 胎盘的角色是滋养胎儿。

slug.zh: 蛞蝓正在吃我們的生菜。

conglomerate.en: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.

rust.en: A bicycle will rust if you leave it in the rain.
rust.zh: 如果你把自行車留在雨中，它會生鏽的。

projector.en: What's wrong with this projector? It won't display anything.
projector.zh: 這個投影儀怎麼了？什麼都放不出來。

eloquent.en: Tom certainly is an eloquent speaker.
eloquent.zh: 汤姆的确是个很会讲话的人。

eloquent.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
eloquent.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

nicotine.en: I'm getting a bit of a nicotine buzz.

ascent.en: The Alpinists carried out the ascent, but they did not return safely.
ascent.zh: 登山者成功登上了山頂，但回程時卻出了意外。

aquarium.en: I needed to add water to my aquarium.
aquarium.zh: 我需要往我的鱼缸里加水。

disgrace.en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
disgrace.zh: 你的行为使全班的人丢脸。

fuse.en: No sooner had Tom turned on the TV than the fuse blew.
fuse.zh: 湯姆一打開電視，保險絲就燒了。

thaw.en: The hoarfrost hasn't yet begun to thaw.
The hoarfrost has not begun to thaw yet.

disintegrate.en: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.
disintegrate.zh: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。

infiltrate.en: Hackers find new ways of infiltrating private or public networks.
infiltrate.zh: 駭客們找到滲透私人或公共網絡的新方法。

extravagant.en: This diamond ring is too extravagant for me.
extravagant.zh: 我覺得這鑽石戒指太奢侈了。

gymnastics.en: We're supposed to do gymnastics now!
You're supposed to do gymnastics now!

encyclopedia.en: I want to leave my name on the encyclopedia.
encyclopedia.zh: 我要在百科全書上留名。

beforehand.en: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.
beforehand.zh: 請你事先把計劃告訴我。

spew.en: Tom keeps spewing out high-end terms, but I know it's all fluff.
spew.zh: 湯姆一直在吐高端術語，但我知道都是虛的。

reptile.en: Fish, amphibians, and reptiles are cold-blooded animals.
reptile.zh: 魚類、兩棲類和爬行類都是冷血動物。

cleanse.en: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
cleanse.zh: 他先清洗了伤口，再绑上绷带。

commend.en: Mark is so honest that everybody commends him for it.
commend.zh: 馬克是如此的誠實所以每個人都讚揚他。

confiscate.en: The package was confiscated by customs.
The teacher confiscated a student's phone because he was texting in class.
confiscate.zh: 老师没收了一个学生的手机，因为他在课上发短信。

preferable.en: I think death is preferable to shame.

viral.en: All those dots are viral focuses.
viral.zh: 这些点都是病毒集中的地方。

patriot.en: The president speaks as a real patriot.
patriot.zh: 总统作为一位真正的爱国者发言。

patriot.en: I'm not a nationalist, I'm a patriot.
patriot.zh: 我不是个民族主义者，我是爱国者。

skyscraper.zh: 阿尔及尔有摩天大楼吗？

skyscraper.en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
skyscraper.zh: 摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。

hilarious.en: The laser cow in WHAT THE CAR? is both hilarious and terrifying!
hilarious.zh: 《WHAT THE CAR?》中的雷射奶牛又好笑又嚇人！

yawn.en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
yawn.zh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。

yawn.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
yawn.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

renounce.en: The Japanese people have renounced war.

gag.en: She was tied up and gagged.
gag.zh: 她被綁起來並堵住了嘴。

humid.en: Summer is always hot and humid.
humid.zh: 夏天总是闷热而又潮湿。

humid.en: Hot and humid weather makes us lazy.
humid.zh: 炎熱潮濕的天氣使我們變得懶散。

immigrate.en: When did you immigrate to our country?

malnutrition.en: Half a million children still face malnutrition in Niger.

impeach.en: You guys in America can impeach your president too.
impeach.zh: 你們美國人也可以彈劾你們的總統。

craze.en: I am still keeping up my tennis craze.
craze.zh: 我仍然热爱着网球运动。

falcon.en: Shahina is an Arabic name meaning "falcon".
falcon.zh: Shahina是阿拉伯名，意思是猎鹰。

scorch.en: In the scorching heat, the cat is spread out lethargically on the ground.
scorch.zh: 在炎热的天气里，猫咪没精神地摊在地上。

ambience.zh: 里面开了一个个欧式的小店，情调好极了！

aristocrat.en: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
aristocrat.zh: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。

hoarse.en: They were all hoarse from shouting.

sparrow.en: The sparrow is singing in the trees.

diligent.zh: 一般來說，日本人很勤奮。

chirp.en: Tom could hear birds chirping outside his window.
chirp.zh: 湯姆能聽到窗外的鳥鳴聲。

chirp.en: The sound of crickets chirping and frogs croaking lulls me to sleep.
chirp.zh: 蟋蟀的叫声与蛙鸣催我入眠。

prune.en: Tell her that I am pruning the trees.

prune.zh: 齊里向里瑪示範如何正確修剪棕櫚樹。

springtime.en: He still has springtime on the brain.

prodigy.en: Mozart: one of the great musical prodigies of all time.
prodigy.zh: 莫札特: 一個永遠的音樂奇才

irritable.en: He is always a little irritable in the morning.
irritable.zh: 他早上总是有点脾气暴躁。

irritable.en: Irritable men are always the last to know about things.
irritable.zh: 脾氣不好的人總是最晚獲知任何訊息。

exposition.en: The exposition will be held for six months.

nimble.en: Poor cat! She can't catch the nimble mouse.
nimble.zh: 可怜的猫！ 她无法抓住敏捷的老鼠。

overload.en: The fridge is overloaded with condiments.

refreshment.en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
refreshment.zh: 茶点过后我们接着开会。

husk.en: I am going to husk rice.

peck.en: He gave her a peck on the cheek.
peck.zh: 他在她的臉上輕輕的親了一下。

peck.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人对诺曼人来说就像妻管严对溺爱妻子的人一样。

hospitable.en: The Algerians are a hospitable people.
hospitable.zh: 阿爾及利亞人是好客的族群。

reek.en: When he came and found me, his whole body reeked of alcohol.
reek.zh: 他来找我的时候全身都是酒的味道。

forsake.en: He could not forsake his friend in trouble.
forsake.zh: 他不会抛下落难的朋友不管。

barbarian.zh: 在教養上，他們可以說是和野蠻人差不多。

stationery.en: All of this stationery is his.

spherical.en: The puck of ice hockey is not spherical.

vogue.en: His novel had a great vogue for a long time.
vogue.zh: 他的小說風行了一段長時間。

vogue.zh: 虽然时髦一点，但是价钱太大！

judgement.en: We can rely on his judgement.
judgement.zh: 我們可以信賴他的判斷。

bleach.en: Don't mix ammonia and bleach together.
bleach.zh: 别把氨水和漂白剂混在一起。

bleach.en: A vase of frost-bleached ferns and ruby-red maple leaves adorned the table.
bleach.zh: 桌上擺放著一瓶被霜凍漂白的蕨類植物和紅寶石色的楓葉。

blacksmith.en: It's by smithing that one becomes a blacksmith.

escalator.en: When using the escalator, please hold the handrail and stand within the yellow line.
escalator.zh: 在乘坐扶梯时，请握住扶手，并站在黄线内。

ripen.en: Their friendship ripened into a deep love.
ripen.zh: 他们的友情酝酿成了爱情。

discord.en: He sows discord by raising controversial subjects.
discord.zh: 他挑起爭議性高的話題，製造紛爭。

discord.en: Finally, the discord between them came to an end.
discord.zh: 他們的衝突終於平息了。

malfunction.en: This clock seems to be malfunctioning.

malfunction.zh: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。

besiege.en: The author of Fortress Besieged is Qian Zhongshu.

selfishness.en: He is a lump of selfishness.
selfishness.zh: 他是个极其自私自利的人。

impotence.en: Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.
impotence.zh: 酗酒是导致阳痿的一个因素。

hummingbird.en: Hummingbirds drink the sweet nectar from certain flowers.
hummingbird.zh: 蜂鳥會吸食某些花朵的甜美花蜜。

null.en: This contract is null and void.
null.zh: 这份合同没有法律效力。

nectar.en: Hummingbirds drink the sweet nectar from certain flowers.
nectar.zh: 蜂鳥會吸食某些花朵的甜美花蜜。

enumerate.en: They are too numerous to enumerate.
enumerate.zh: 他们人太多了，数不过来。

refurbish.en: I might consider buying a refurbished phone.
refurbish.zh: 我可能也會購買整修品。

inferiority.en: How can I rid myself of my inferiority complex?
inferiority.zh: 我有什麼辦法可以脫離我的自卑情結嗎？

lyric.en: I like lyric better than epic.
lyric.zh: 我喜歡抒情詩多於史詩。

lyric.zh: 我找到了歌词，但是没法转贴过来。

acupuncture.zh: 很多人都相信針灸有治癒疾病的功效。

acupuncture.zh: 很多人都相信針灸有治癒疾病的功效。

censure.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
censure.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

grasshopper.en: That's not a grasshopper. It's a locust!
That's not a cricket, that's a grasshopper.

contrive.en: He contrived a means of speaking to Nancy privately.
contrive.zh: 他用了一些手段来和Nancy私下交谈。

vaccinate.en: I was vaccinated against the flu.

octopus.en: The octopus is in the sea.
I've never eaten a live octopus.

emigrant.en: The emigrants have endured physical and mental pain.
emigrant.zh: 移民们忍受着肉体和精神的痛苦。

fruitless.en: The matter can't be changed. No matter how hard we try, everything is fruitless.
fruitless.zh: 事情已经定下来了，我们再怎么努力也无济于事了，一切都是马后炮了。

hoe.en: Be careful when working with a hoe.
hoe.zh: 用锄头的时候小心一些

hilly.en: Chongqing is a hilly city with winding streets.
hilly.zh: 重庆是一座丘陵的城市，道路弯弯曲曲的。

insinuate.en: Fine words and an insinuating appearance are seldom associated with true virtue.

fickle.en: A woman is ever fickle and changeable.
I'll eat almost anything, but I'm very fickle when it comes to cheese.
fickle.zh: 我是甚麼都吃的那種人，但是吃起司卻很講心情。

tolerable.en: Your actions are tolerable, as a kid.
tolerable.zh: 作为一个孩子，你的表现还说得过去

boundless.en: Boundless snow covered all that could be seen.
boundless.zh: 无边的白雪罩住了目所能及的一切。

saber.en: It was during the ice age that the saber-toothed tiger became extinct.
saber.zh: 劍齒虎是在冰河時期絕種的。

circumference.en: Is it possible to determine the diameter from the circumference?
circumference.zh: 用圓周能不能求得直徑？

concise.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
concise.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

rant.zh: 那個男人大聲咆哮，但她訓練有素的客服式微笑始終沒有消退。

bondage.en: He liberated the people from bondage.

bondage.zh: 我想她想要的是束縛與支配。

superfluous.en: There was always too much superfluous writing in his essays.
superfluous.zh: 在他的文章中总是有太多肤浅的桥段。

detest.en: I detest everyone, and everyone detests me.
detest.zh: 我厌恶每个人，每个人都厌恶我。

diagonally.zh: 有一家便利店在马路斜对面。

despicable.en: I am ashamed of your despicable deed.
despicable.zh: 我为你的卑鄙行径感到羞耻。

barometer.zh: 气压计下降了 - 要下雨了。

collusion.en: The sports world should, at this time, eliminate the collusion with criminal organizations.
collusion.zh: 在这个时候，体育世界应当减少犯罪组织的勾结。

carelessly.zh: 我不小心打落了一个花瓶。

carelessly.en: They were carelessly unaware of the danger.
carelessly.zh: 他们粗心大意，还没意识到危险。

evasive.zh: 你为什么这么含糊其辞？

televise.zh: 一起去體育館吧，因爲今天的比賽沒有電視轉播。

underdeveloped.en: This area is still underdeveloped because of a lack of interest from the government.

monotonous.zh: 我厌倦了现在单调的生活。

supremely.en: I am supremely glad to hear it.

drowsy.zh: 晚飯後她變得昏昏欲睡。

considerate.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。

monopolize.zh: 他們壟斷了原物料供應，並開天價。

monopolize.zh: 在這次會議上, 他壟斷了討論並徹底打亂了議程。

unexplored.en: The deep layers of the ocean are still almost unexplored.

blemish.zh: 她的肌肤如同牛奶一样洁白，身上没有一处斑点。

conceit.zh: 世界只能容忍有成就的人的自傲。

gratify.en: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
gratify.zh: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

lithe.en: Love me lithe, love me long.
lithe.zh: 淡淡地愛我，長久地愛我。

supposition.zh: 这是建立在猜测的基础上。

aurora.zh: 極光是極地特有的自然現象。

reproach.zh: 他責備了我的粗心大意。

facsimile.zh: 您能把地图传真给我吗？

curt.zh: 你回答得這麼簡短，不覺得有點沒禮貌嗎？

rejuvenate.zh: 朋友之间，大家谈谈心，非常爽快。

industrious.zh: 勤劳的人将在生活中获得成功。

repute.en: He is reputed the best lawyer in this city.
repute.zh: 他被认为是这座城市里最好的律师。

quench.zh: 你有没有什么喝的给我解渴吗？

comprehensible.zh: 法律術語是大多數普通人無法理解的。

anesthetic.zh: 他在麻醉剂的作用下，他失去了知觉。

ponderous.en: The old professor's lectures are long-winded and ponderous.
ponderous.zh: 这位老教授的讲座冗长而沉闷。

infallible.en: He believes himself to be infallible.

scrupulous.en: You can see that the architect paid scrupulous attention to detail.
scrupulous.zh: 這位建築師顯然是一位無微不至的建築師。

foretell.en: No one can foretell the future.

foretell.zh: 我數著星宿的星光來預測我愛情的未來。

atrophy.zh: 他的腿部肌肉在他卧床不起的七个月中萎缩了。

lustrous.zh: 王冠上鑲嵌著數十顆光彩奪目的寶石。

venomous.zh: 別用怨恨的眼神看我啦。

apathetic.en: It is said that the younger generation today is apathetic.
apathetic.zh: 有人说新一代的人很冷漠。

disagreeable.zh: 他是個很討人煩的男人。

disagreeable.en: What a disagreeable fellow he is!
disagreeable.zh: 他可真是個讓人討厭的傢伙！

hazel.en: You have such beautiful, hazel eyes.
hazel.zh: 你有如此美麗的淡褐色眼睛。

abbreviation.en: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom.

drudgery.en: With all its sham, drudgery and broken dreams; it is still a beautiful world.
drudgery.zh: 虽然虚伪、苦痛还有破碎的梦伴随着我，但这仍然是一个美丽的世界。

thatch.zh: 這棟很高的房子被茅草屋頂覆蓋著。

culpable.en: According to what she said, he's culpable.
culpable.zh: 根據她所說的, 他是有罪的。

sociable.zh: 我去那個派對純粹是為了交際。

seashore.zh: 阿尔及尔有一条美丽的海滨长廊。

swampy.zh: 你不能在沼澤地上建造建築物。

begrudge.zh: 我们的老板就连给我们涨一点工资都舍不得。

capsize.zh: 那艘船失去平衡，翻了過來。

footpath.zh: 田野和小徑被霧氣籠罩著。

perishable.en: During hot season, perishables go bad easily.
perishable.zh: 在炎熱的季節時，有些食品很容易變壞。

pollination.zh: 例如，如果沒有蜜蜂授粉，加州的杏仁作物就不會存在。

pollination.zh: 沒有授粉，我們就吃不到水果和蔬菜。

frost.en: We had a heavy frost this morning.
A vase of frost-bleached ferns and ruby-red maple leaves adorned the table.
frost.zh: 桌上擺放著一瓶被霜凍漂白的蕨類植物和紅寶石色的楓葉。

thrifty.en: He is thrifty, not to say stingy.
thrifty.zh: 他勤俭节约，甚至是小气的。

hornet.en: A swarm of hornets attacked the children.
hornet.zh: 一窩黃蜂襲擊了孩子們。

walkout.en: The railroad workers are going on walkout tomorrow.
walkout.zh: 鐵路工人明天將繼續進行罷工。

infirmary.en: You'd better go to the infirmary.
It was cold in the infirmary.

brook.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

taxicab.en: Call a taxicab to take us.

abbreviate.en: Science-Fiction can be abbreviated as sci-fi.
abbreviate.zh: 科學幻想的簡稱是科幻。

abhorrent.en: Such an idea is abhorrent to her.

aglow.en: The heater is aglow with a beautiful orange color.
aglow.zh: 加熱器發出美麗的橙色光芒。

frugality.en: By frugality she managed to get along on her small salary.
frugality.zh: 凭着节俭，她设法以自己微薄的薪水生活。

comport.en: When one is in difficulty and comports themselves well, that is a master.

convex.en: If human life is convex, we can optimize it.
convex.zh: 如果人生是凸的，那我们可以优化它。

bay.en: The airport is in Osaka Bay.
Mt. Fuji as seen from Suruga Bay is beautiful.
bay.zh: 從駿河灣看, 富士山很美麗。

gild.en: While the rest of us work hard, the robber barons eat with gilded utensils.
gild.zh: 當我們其他人辛苦工作時，強盜貴族卻用鍍金餐具吃飯。

pollinate.en: Figs are pollinated by fig wasps.

guile.en: I refuse to be taken in by her guile.
guile.zh: 我是不會被她的詭計騙倒的。

melodious.en: The song of this bird is very melodious.
melodious.zh: 这只鸟唱的歌十分动听。

gemstone.en: The crown is adorned with dozens of divinely lustrous gemstones.
gemstone.zh: 王冠上鑲嵌著數十顆光彩奪目的寶石。

tableware.en: This restaurant serves French cuisine, but with Japanese tableware.
tableware.zh: 這家餐廳供應法國菜，但使用日式餐具。

tableware.en: While the rest of us toil, the robber barons eat from gilt tableware.
tableware.zh: 當我們其他人辛苦工作時，強盜貴族卻用鍍金餐具吃飯。

foist.en: He foisted a bunch of hard work on me.
foist.zh: 他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。

swelter.zh: 台灣的夏天很潮濕悶熱。

ford.en: Mr Ford is all right now.
I forgot to call up Mr Ford.
ford.zh: 我忘了给福特先生打电话。

telegraph.en: Do you know who invented the telegraph?
telegraph.zh: 你知道誰發明了電報機嗎？

miser.en: The miser opened the box to find his money stolen.
miser.zh: 這個守財奴打開了盒子，發現他的錢被偷了。

overconfident.en: You should be careful not to become overconfident.

potter.en: The new Harry Potter movie is pretty lame.
potter.zh: 哈利波特的新片十分差。

potter.en: I already read all the Harry Potter books.
potter.zh: 我已经读完了所有哈利·波特书。

fallacious.en: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
fallacious.zh: 她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。

impudent.en: The old man assumed an impudent attitude.
impudent.zh: 老人採取了傲慢的態度。

impudent.en: We mustn't give way to these impudent demands.
impudent.zh: 我們絕不會接受這些橫蠻無理的要求。

impartially.en: Teachers should treat all their students impartially.
impartially.zh: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。

idiomatic.en: Is it more idiomatic if I say it like this?
idiomatic.zh: 这样说是不是更加地道呢？

hexagon.en: A hexagon has six angles and six sides.
hexagon.zh: 六邊形有六個角、六條邊。

actuate.en: This device is actuated by a switch.
actuate.zh: 這個裝置是用開關啟動的。

hovercraft.en: My hovercraft is full of eels.

endeavour.en: We will endeavour to finish the job by the end of the week.
endeavour.zh: 我們會盡力在這禮拜結束前把工作完成。

byword.en: The name Cleopatra has become a byword for a beautiful woman.
byword.zh: 「克里奧帕特拉」這個名字已經成為了美女的代名詞。

bush.zh: 布什继里根之后当上了总统。

tableland.en: Tableland vegetables are grown here, such as lettuce, cabbage, and celery.
tableland.zh: 這裡種植有生菜、高麗菜和芹菜等高原蔬菜。

manoeuvre.en: Do you know the Heimlich manoeuvre?
manoeuvre.zh: 你知道海姆利克急救法吗？

euphonious.en: In the evening quiet, we enjoy the song of the euphonious nightingale.
euphonious.zh: 在安静的晚上，我们沉浸在夜莺悦耳的歌声中。

quadrilateral.en: A parallelogram is a quadrilateral formed from two sets of parallel lines.
quadrilateral.zh: 平行四邊形是由兩組平行線組成的四邊形。

airsickness.en: Please bring me some medicine for airsickness.

pearl.en: These pearls are genuine, not artificial.
pearl.zh: 这些珍珠是真的，不是人造的。

flavour.zh: 這個酸奶是什麼口味的？

pants.en: You just got pantsed in the schoolyard, four-eyes.
pants.zh: 你跟他比可差远了，四眼田鸡。

ounce.en: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.
ounce.zh: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。

calorie.en: High calorie foods are bad for my health.
calorie.zh: 高卡路里的食物對我的身體不好。

millennia.en: Indigenous Australians have eaten kangaroos for millennia.
millennia.zh: 澳大利亚土著已经吃了上千年袋鼠。

congratulation.zh: 衷心祝賀你的生日，穆里爾！

fahrenheit.en: The temperature today is seventy degrees Fahrenheit.
fahrenheit.zh: 今天气温是华氏七十度。

celsius.en: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
Water will freeze at zero Celsius, right?
celsius.zh: 攝氏零度時水會結冰，對吧？

bereave.en: The accident bereaved her of her husband.

phenomena.en: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.
phenomena.zh: 彩虹是自然界最美的现象之一。

phenomena.en: Three out of four Americans believe in the existence of paranormal phenomena.
phenomena.zh: 四分之三的美国人相信存在超自然现象。

teens.en: She got married in her teens.
My sister got married in her teens.
teens.zh: 我妹妹在她十幾歲時就結婚。
